outcome: When a v-model binding carries both .trim and .number, the number conversion is applied to the trimmed value rather than to the raw one

acceptance_criteria.text: With both modifiers set, emitting a non-numeric string delivers the trimmed string to the listener, not the untrimmed one.

expected_verification.assertion: emitting '  hello  ' with modelModifiers { trim: true, number: true } calls the listener with 'hello'

acceptance_criteria.text: The existing behaviour of each modifier on its own is unchanged: .number alone still converts a numeric string to a number, and .trim alone still trims only string arguments.

expected_verification.assertion: the pre-existing componentEmits tests for .number and for .trim continue to pass
